show.description_secondary: When a massive storm traps a ruthless billionaire and a humble engineer in a race against time, greed and conscience collide. As disaster looms over the Himalayan valley, one man’s arrogance meets another’s courage. From boardrooms to broken dams, Engineer vs Billionaires is a high-octane survival drama where nature takes revenge, power is tested, and redemption comes at the cost of pride.
